evidence: Literal sound paths from both 2010 clients, plus PowerIncreaseEffect HP/MP/YEN and SoloDefenseEffect block/flick/reflect dynamic paths. Missing names also occur in the 2013 client; substitutes below are functional choices, not verified renames or historical recordings.

entry_over.mp3.reason: Entry-button hover uses the available generic button-hover effect.

entry_down.mp3.reason: Entry-button clicks use the available generic button-click effect.

entry_toggle_down.mp3.reason: Entry selection uses the available generic toggle-click effect.

bonus.mp3.reason: Currency bonuses use the available currency-increase effect.

score.mp3.reason: End-game score presentation uses the available winner effect.

yen_scatter.mp3.reason: Distributed currency gains use the available currency-increase effect.

devil.mp3.reason: Damaging creatures use the available damage effect.

itazuraman.mp3.reason: Artifact or miracle removal by Trickman uses the available removal effect.

megumi_san.mp3.reason: Helpful creatures use an available recovery effect, including MP/currency variants.

illusion.mp3.reason: Random-action Illusion uses the available related Illusion-item effect; these are different gameplay effects.
